rules.statement: A deed does not create a valid fidei commissum unless it can be fairly gathered from the language used that the donor intended to benefit a particular class by prohibiting alienation of property.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is impossible to presume an intention to create a fidei commissum, unless it can fairly be gathered from the language used that the donor intended that Fidelis Boteju should only have a life estate in the property which, on his death, was to pass to a person or class of persons clearly designated."
